claims.statement: EU law requires clear and transparent provisions for measuring and verifying guaranteed savings, quality checks, and guarantees in energy performance contracts.

The Energy Efficiency Directive requires public bodies to assess EPC feasibility for renovations of large non-residential buildings above 750 square metres and promotes independent market intermediaries, but does not mandate a specific software vendor.
Polish guidance describes EPC as a multi-year arrangement in which an ESCO guarantees savings and bears material financial risk.
The Polish model contract places annual savings reporting and correction of justified objections with the ESCO and depends on owner-supplied invoices, meter data, and information about changing use.
KAPE estimates that more than 125000 Polish public buildings need energy modernization, supporting a large need pool but not proving EPC adoption or paid M&V demand.
KAPE and a law firm already offer an EPC facilitator service spanning preparation, ESCO selection, technical and legal oversight, monitoring, and settlement control.
EVO states that advanced M&V cannot be fully automated and generally needs a human in the loop to handle unstable operations and contextualize outputs.
EVO describes independent verifiers as typically experienced engineering consultants, so software auditability alone does not establish professional independence.
Natural Resources Canada posts RETScreen Professional at CAD 869 per year and offers Viewer mode without charge, creating a low-cost calculation and portfolio alternative.

EnergyCAP offers established whole-facility IPMVP cost-avoidance calculations and states that complex ESCO or multivariable cases need more advanced methods and more data than monthly bills may provide.
The differentiated wedge is therefore governed data lineage, dual-party visibility, adjustment approvals, and expert sign-off rather than an autonomous savings oracle.
A reusable benchmark moat is conditional because meter data, contract terms, and adjustment rationales may be confidential and require explicit rights for de-identification and reuse.
Paid site count, software budget ownership, dispute frequency, reviewer cost, data connectivity, procurement cycle, and partner willingness remain unknown.

No direct evidence reviewed proves illegality, unobtainable essential rights, impossible conservative economics, or a non-delegable founder incompatibility; feasibility remains conditional on contracts, authorized data access, and a qualified independent reviewer.

contrary_evidence: Neither EU law nor the Polish model contract mandates a separate independent software service; the Polish template places reporting with the ESCO.
Advanced M&V cannot be fully automated and depends on experienced engineering judgment for non-routine events.
RETScreen is free in Viewer mode and CAD 869 yearly in Professional mode, while EnergyCAP already supplies mature M&V calculations.
KAPE's facilitator service already bundles monitoring, legal and technical oversight, and settlement control in Poland.
More than 125000 buildings needing modernization is not evidence of EPC contract count, software budget, or conversion.
Neutrality is questionable if one contract party alone pays and controls the service without dual-party governance and independent review.
